docs.title: R15 Wildlife Monitoring Rover
docs.text: Welcome to the R15 User & Safety Manual. This manual describes setup, operation, and safety procedures for the R15 mobile platform.

docs.title: First Run
docs.text:
1. Power the rover.
  2. Connect rover & laptop to the same Wi-Fi.
  3. SSH into the rover: ```bash ssh pi@

docs.title: What You’ll Need
docs.text:
• R15 rover (assembled) with Raspberry Pi & camera
  • 12 V DC supply or Li-ion battery (≥ 5000 mAh)
  • Control laptop (Wi-Fi)
  • Router/Hotspot (2.4/5 GHz)
  • USB-C cable; optional gamepad
  • Python 3.10+, SSH client, Git, browser
